from_quote: their judicial character as a court for the trial of impeachments
rationale: Names the Senate's "judicial character as a court for the trial of impeachments" as a power the plan allots to it, echoing this clause's "try all Impeachments."
to_quote: The Senate shall have the sole Power to try all Impeachments

from_quote: their participation with the executive in the appointment to offices
rationale: Names the Senate's "participation with the executive in the appointment to offices" as a power the plan allots to it; the Senate's part in appointments is given in this clause.
to_quote: by and with the Advice and Consent of the Senate, shall appoint

from_quote: he will still be liable to prosecution and punishment in the ordinary course of law
rationale: Says one convicted on impeachment "will still be liable to prosecution and punishment in the ordinary course of law" and speaks of "dismission from a present, and disqualification for a future, office," echoing this clause's words.
to_quote: the Party convicted shall nevertheless be liable and subject to Indictment, Trial, Judgment and Punishment, according to Law

from_quote: making the chief justice of the Supreme Court the president of the court of impeachments, as is proposed to be done in the plan of the convention
rationale: Names the plan's making "the chief justice of the Supreme Court the president of the court of impeachments," echoing this clause's "the Chief Justice shall preside."
